LESSON: WAVES

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: GENERAL SCIENCE
Strand: Natural Physical Science
Topic 3.3: Waves
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 14

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Waves, part of Natural Physical Science in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 GENERAL SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How are waves applicable in our day-to-day life? 2. How do waves affect our environment?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Waves together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Learning to learn: as the learner searches for information using digital devices with assistive technology on

applications of reflection, refraction and diffraction of waves.

● Critical thinking and problem solving: as the learner searches for information using print media in appropriate

colour contrast and font or braille learning materials on mitigation measures of the effects of waves on the

environment (communities, ecosystems, infrastructure and operations)

Values:
Unity: as the learners play different roles when carrying out experiments to investigate reflection of sound waves using the

echo method.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
● Safety and security: as the learner appreciates some of the applications of waves related to safety in transport.

● Environmental issues: as the learner searches for information on the effect of waves on the environment

(communities, marine ecosystems, infrastructure and operations).

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Print textbooks in appropriate font and colour.

• Braille textbooks.

• Digital devices with assistive technology such as screen readers and screen magnifiers.

• Real objects like starter, gun e.t.c

Key Skills:

● Calculate the wave characteristics using the wave equation.

● Demonstrate the effects of properties of waves in real life.
